name: Automic Vault
category: Local execution security and secrets management
title: Run agents full access. Don’t lose sleep.
tagline: The missing secrets manager for developers.
description: Automic Vault keeps developer credentials on your Mac and authorizes the exact operation before a supported Tool can use them.

difference.conventional_model: Check an identity and Secret Name before returning the stored value.
difference.automic_vault_model: Check the complete operation before applying requested Secrets.
difference.boundary: Automic Vault controls Secret Application. The Target controls a Secret after receipt.

features.tool_hardening: Hardeners reconfigure or patch a supported credential-bearing Tool so its Authorization Gate applies below any one agent harness.
features.project_values: One Secret Name can select the nearest Project Value for the physical working directory, then a Global Value.
features.temporary_access_grants: Eligible agent tasks can receive visible, in-memory ten-minute write authority for one Verified Launcher and Tool-specific gate.
features.iphone_approval: An optional iPhone app can carry every human Approval for an enrolled Mac while the Mac remains the Local Execution Boundary.
features.blessed_scripts: Blessings bind an exact path, contents, Secret Names, and declared Tool capabilities.
features.reentrant_blessed_scripts: Agents use fixed, reviewed script entry points without general access to the underlying Tools, MCP servers, or Secret Values. Automic Vault authorizes every invocation separately.
features.launcher_bundles: Exact single-file Mach-O CLI snapshots can be signed, installed root-owned, enrolled, and revalidated on every request.
features.aws: Normal AWS invocations receive short-lived STS credentials from a native helper.
features.docker: Credential release verifies the live vendor-signed Docker process, ancestry, arguments, and requested registry.
features.homebrew: Execution policy separates reads and update from installs and upgrades.
features.detection: Over 100 supported developer configurations are checked for Exposures and Hazards.
features.authorization_history: Allowed and denied requests leave bounded local history.

security_boundaries: Automic Vault does not intercept every process or replace the shell.
Automic Vault does not prevent arbitrary local destruction.
Automic Vault does not contain root or kernel compromise.
Code signing proves identity and integrity, not intent.
A Target can leak a Secret after receiving it.
iPhone Approval has no Mac allow fallback; an unavailable phone or relay leaves the request waiting for its Gate Client to cancel.
iPhone Mirroring and Show on Mac can expose Approval controls when per-device biometrics are disabled.
Project Directories and agent task identifiers are not authorization identities.
Authorization History is not tamperproof or audit-complete.
